result.summary: Replaces hardcoded extended key string literals (tpub/tprv) across 10 functional test files with dynamically generated keys using the ExtendedPrivateKey test framework helper. This continues adoption of the extended key test classes introduced in PR #35543.
result.problem: Multiple functional tests rely on hardcoded extended key string constants rather than using the ExtendedKey test framework helper classes, leaving inconsistent key generation patterns across tests.
evidence: "This PR is a follow-up of PR #35543. I've updated the tests that were still using hardcoded keys, and used the ExtendedKey classes instead." (PR description)
result.changed_since_previous: Rebased with no substantive changes to the approach or files touched.
result.card: This PR replaces hardcoded extended key strings (tpub/tprv) with dynamically generated keys using the ExtendedPrivateKey test framework helper across 10 functional test files. It continues test framework modernization following PR #35543. This is an internal test cleanup with no impact on node behavior or production code.

risk.why: A mistake in test key generation would cause functional test failures without affecting production node code or consensus.
